name: UWC
recent: UWC 正在推进一项最多 55,190,955 股新股（约占已发行股本 5%）的私募配售计划，Bursa Securities 已于 2026 年 10 月 12 日批准相关上市。公司同时于 9 月底公布最新季度业绩，营收与净利均录得环比和同比增长。此外，公司于 9 月 30 日更换公司秘书。
notable: 190,955 股新股，约占已发行股本 5%，Bursa Securities 已批准上市。
公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度业绩，营收与净利环比及同比均增长。
公司秘书 Chong Kwai Yoong 变更。
risks: 私募配售最多 5% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股比例。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度，营收为 MYR 186.177 million，环比增长 22.9%，同比增长 71.1%；净利为 MYR 37.598 million，环比增长 42.9%，同比增长 129.7%；净利率为 20.2%，高于上一季度的 17.4%。

recent_en: UWC is undertaking a proposed placement of up to 55,190,955 new shares (about 5% of issued shares), with Bursa Securities approving the listing on 12 October 2026. The company also released its latest quarterly results in late September, with revenue and net profit rising both QoQ and YoY. It also changed its company secretary on 30 September.
notable_en: Proposed placement of up to 55,190,955 new shares, about 5% of issued shares, with Bursa Securities approving the listing.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026, with revenue and net profit rising QoQ and YoY.
Change of company secretary, Chong Kwai Yoong.
risks_en: The placement of up to 5% new shares may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue was MYR 186.177 million, up 22.9% QoQ and 71.1% YoY; net profit was MYR 37.598 million, up 42.9% QoQ and 129.7% YoY; net margin was 20.2%, higher than 17.4% in the previous quarter.
